name: rapid non-sequitur stream of consciousness
description: Tests the engine's resilience when the user rapidly shifts between completely unrelated topics with no transition or coherence. Verifies that the engine does not crash, that topic tracking handles the rapid shifts without error, and that the engine maintains composure.
